description: Full limit-technique drill set from the Start Up Community BAC II exercise compendium: direct substitution, rational-function 0/0 factoring, radical (sqrt/cube-root) 0/0 forms, limits at infinity (rational/exponential/log), sinc (sin x/x) and tan-based trig limits, exponential/log standard limits (e^x-1)/x and ln(1+x)/x, (1+k/x)^x forms, and past-exam collections.

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math exercise compendium (Start Up Community), Lesson 2: លីមីត (Limits) — exercises only, no worked solutions
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-28

exercises.technique: factoring_0_0: factor out (x-a) from numerator and denominator via polynomial division, cancel, substitute
factoring_0_0 with symbolic exponent n or general point a: uses x^n-a^n=(x-a)(x^{n-1}+...+a^{n-1})

exercises.technique: rationalization_conjugate_finite: multiply by conjugate radical (sqrt or a^2-ab+b^2 factoring for cube roots) to remove the 0/0 indeterminate form
rational_function_infinity: compare polynomial degrees (divide by highest power) for rational forms; conjugate_infinity: multiply by conjugate to resolve infinity-minus-infinity for sqrt forms
